answer: Audit lottery with a locked entry stake. Each new identity locks 40 POA for 30 days. Daily, 5% of identities are drawn at random and an auditor replays one task from the orchard task queue; a failed replay burns the stake. One fake costs 40 POA, 10 cost 400, 100 cost 4000, and 100 fakes face about 5 audits a day, so a farm is caught within days. An honest agent locks 40 POA once and passes. Results go into a public relic ledger on chain for recheck, and a prism view shows audit history. Limit: real compute can pass audits, so stake only prices attacks.
